rca_of_the_issue.bug: guide-app verifyDevice() always returns undefined for valid devices
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: GET /api/devices/guide/{device_id} returns {channels, programs, device, access_info} — no 'authorized' field. App.jsx verifyDevice checks res.data.authorized which is undefined. In JavaScript, if(undefined) is false, so the else branch runs: localStorage.removeItem('sv_device') + setAuthState('unactivated'). This means on every page reload after activation, the user would be forced to re-enter credentials.
rca_of_the_issue.reproduction: 1. Activate a device via POST /api/customer/activate-with-credentials. 2. On the guide-app, sv_device is stored in localStorage. 3. Reload the guide-app page. 4. verifyDevice() is called with the device_id. 5. GET /api/devices/guide/{device_id} returns 200 with channels data (no authorized field). 6. res.data.authorized = undefined. 7. App sets authState='unactivated', removes sv_device. 8. ActivationGate shows (user must re-enter credentials).
rca_of_the_issue.fix: Option A (backend): Add 'authorized': True to GET /api/devices/guide/{device_id} response before returning. Option B (frontend): Change verifyDevice() to: return res.data.device?.status === 'active'; OR simply: return res.status === 200;
